observations.rationale: Cart contents, customer history, and recommendations do not carry across channels. Customers who browse online and purchase in-store (or vice versa) encounter a broken experience, reducing conversion and NPS.

evidence.excerpt: Omnichannel NPS 45 vs 60 target. Pain point: 'No integration between online and in-store experiences' (Medium, Short-Term). Competitor pain point: 'Competitors provide an integrated omnichannel shopping experience; our online and in-store experience is disconnected' (High, Behind).

observations.rationale: Customers planning complex projects (kitchens, bathrooms, renovations) cannot complete planning digitally — they must attend store. Design advisory capability is not available online, creating a channel bottleneck at in-store design consultation.

evidence.excerpt: Pain point: 'Customers struggle with complex purchases (e.g., kitchens)' (High, Short-Term). Customer Journey: 'Planning and Building a Kitchen' — NPS High, Lead Time Long. Strategy: 'Own the DIY Planning Journey' (2025).

bindingConstraint.justification: Primary constraint identified within vs_in_store_sales value stream.
